```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1. Colors by response variable (your mapping)
#-------------------------------------------------
response_colors <- c(
  "Total Zn (nM)"                              = "slategray",
  "Bioavailable Zn (nmol/g wet weight)"        = "darkslategray3",
  "Proportion of Bioavailable Zn (Free/Total)" = "turquoise",
  "Total Cu (nM)"                              = "chocolate4",
  "Bioavailable Cu (nmol/g wet weight)"        = "peru",
  "Proportion of Bioavailable Cu (Free/Total)" = "chocolate1"
)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 2. Map variable names -> response labels
#-------------------------------------------------
response_lookup <- c(
  "log_Zn_nM"         = "Total Zn (nM)",
  "log_TBL_Zn_nmol_g" = "Bioavailable Zn (nmol/g wet weight)",
  "log_rel_prop_Zn"   = "Proportion of Bioavailable Zn (Free/Total)",
  "log_Cu_nM"         = "Total Cu (nM)",
  "log_TBL_Cu_nmol_g" = "Bioavailable Cu (nmol/g wet weight)",
  "log_rel_prop_Cu"   = "Proportion of Bioavailable Cu (Free/Total)"
)

vars_trace <- names(response_lookup)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 3. Custom multipliers for letter heights per plot
#    (names must match Response labels)
#-------------------------------------------------
letter_nudge <- c(
  "Total Zn (nM)"                              = 1,
  "Bioavailable Zn (nmol/g wet weight)"        = 2,
  "Proportion of Bioavailable Zn (Free/Total)" = 1,
  "Total Cu (nM)"                              = 1,
  "Bioavailable Cu (nmol/g wet weight)"        = 2,
  "Proportion of Bioavailable Cu (Free/Total)" = 1
)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 4. Long data for plotting (use Typology)
#-------------------------------------------------
dat_long_trace <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(Typology, all_of(vars_trace)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -Typology,
    names_to  = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  mutate(
    Response = response_lookup[Variable],
    Response = factor(Response, levels = names(response_colors))
  )

#-------------------------------------------------
# 5. Letters (from letters_df) for all 6 variables
#-------------------------------------------------

# 5a. Max y per Variable x Typology
y_pos_df <- dat_long_trace %>%
  group_by(Variable, Typology) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 5b. Attach Response + y positions + nudges to letters_df
#     letters_df must have: Variable, Typology, Letters
letters_long_trace <- letters_df %>%
  filter(Variable %in% vars_trace) %>%
  mutate(
    Response = response_lookup[Variable],
    Response = factor(Response, levels = names(response_colors))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    y_pos_df,
    by = c("Variable", "Typology")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # add different nudge per facet
    y_pos = y_max + letter_nudge[as.character(Response)]
  )

#-------------------------------------------------
# 6. One faceted trace element panel (x = Typology)
#-------------------------------------------------
bioavail_panel <- ggplot(dat_long_trace, aes(
    x     = Typology,
    y     = Value,
    color = Response
  )) +
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.6) +
  
  # Jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size  = 1,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Letters from Kruskal groups
  geom_text(
    data = letters_long_trace,
    aes(
      x     = Typology,
      y     = y_pos,
      label = Letters
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  # Colors by response (your palette)
  scale_color_manual(values = response_colors) +
  
  # One facet per response variable
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Response,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol   = 3
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Trace Elements by Stream Typology",
    x     = "Stream Typology"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 14)
  )

# View
bioavail_panel

# Save as square
ggsave(
  filename = file.path("Trace_elements_panel_square.png"),
  plot     = bioavail_panel,
  width    = 8.5,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300
)

# Save as rectangle
ggsave(
  filename = file.path("Trace_elements_panel_long.png"),
  plot     = bioavail_panel,
  width    = 12,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300
)
```
